source.title: WCA Regulations — May 2019
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

The WRC would like to inform you about the versions of the WCA Regulations and Guidelines, which are going into effect May 1, 2019.

You can review all changes in [this comparison on GitHub](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/compare/official-2018-01-01...release-candidate-2019-04-04). If you do not want to open all the individual changes, you can click on “Files changed” to see the complete files of the regulation and guidelines. All changes and additions are marked green and removals are red.

Round format changes:

- Means are now recognized for 4x4x4 Blindfolded and 5x5x5 Blindfolded "Best of 3" rounds. ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/8b3a38bf71836c42eab409f574612daee6a124f4) | [discussion](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/539))
- The "Best of X" format has been removed from all events except blindfolded events and 3x3x3 Fewest Moves. ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/bc7e6cc28c5e1f4928951460159db5861b6fe773) | [discussion](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/576), [commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/92e626ba258998524cfe279d88f9c7b0d7acee93) | [discussion](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/658), [commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/76157f0013a3de06c50f413e4194e6a439d4382e) | [discussion](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/693))

Competition organization changes:
<!-- break -->
- Scramble signatures should be used for all competitions ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/8ef591a2c276ce775149de5e6bba30ae160d14e3) | [discussion](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/214) | [discussion](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/591) | [discusssion](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/640))
  - Scramble signatures are planned to become mandatory in 2020.
- The WCA Delegate must not give scramblers (or anyone else) access to scramble sequences for any group before it has begun. ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/fb33a890cff5ecc10107691fee550084dad36209))
  - Note that [TNoodle 0.14.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/posts/tnoodle-0-14-0) includes scramble set PDFs with individual passcodes to help with this.
- Time limits have been clarified ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/ea2d719fe5d7eb11ce210a9499aa1c5f4627560d))
  - Time limits must be announced before the competition, rather than just before the
  round.
  - Only one cumulative time limit can apply to a given round.
  - Cumulative time limits include time elapsed in DNF attempts.
  - The judge and WCA Delegate may estimate cumulative elapsed time ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/52ce26093bd769dcee90ec925cef0d7a002dbdfa))
- Scramblers should be visually isolated from competitors. ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/21c1c3cc44816c1064d9ac4dbb14bc0e53b8ecaa))
- Many competition requirements have been moved from the Regulations to the new [WCA Competition Requirements Policy](https://github.com/thewca/wca-documents/pull/40) ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/476f11632d025ec500cdedd5b964b35051f7bd4f))

Other substantial changes and clarifications:

- Individual non-permitted puzzles in multi BLD may count as unsolved instead of DNFing the whole attempt, at the discretion of the Delegate. ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/dfaecca2213de51e7d638b623d3976f95c671fbd) | [discussion](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/545))
- Clarified that competitors start the attempt for blindfolded events, and that they must ask the judge before "testing" a timer. ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/2879c0dbdb3f4c33f7bca80b8dc5a725fc7f8f5f) | [discussion](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/717))
- Competitors are allowed to have hand warmers and food at certain times, at the discretion of the Delegate. ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/7802b0e2f48f6c7f87e78162aaad99601da33fcf) | [discussion](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/700))
- The competitor must not ask for assistance during a pop, and the judge should prevent others from assisting. If someone picks up a popped part for the competitor, the judge or competitor may ask them to place it on the solving station and not to assist any further. ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/e3f2769c27d1d0e5039fa799d5be1922122da328) | [discussion](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/624))
- The competitor may touch the official stopwatch, unless the organization team provides an unofficial stopwatch for the competitor. ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/c66106e266e5b580218f4273f7db4dddd5a55b8d) | [discussion](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/581))
- Starting the timer always ends inspection and begins the solve. This means that the competitor cannot "test" the timer once inspection has begun. ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/fff14fe406fbe42b4f034d6ffe2df35462f3f994) | [discussion](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/573))
- It is explicitly forbidden to cause puzzle defects intentionally. ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/18a136749214dbfd8248f58153e23c0d4eb7d95b) | [discussion](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/538))
- If there are multiple green faces next to the top face, the darkest is placed in front for scrambling. ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/38e00b10f793e7830ee3dafccdf18f753e6cc43e))
- We've specified that Multi-Blind result times are always rounded to seconds, matching the results database. ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/2d3bac31ed17f8c21d275f3f9fe7674ae8bb92bf))
- Notation for NxNxN cubes has been clarified ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/8104b4b795b2e9e993cdd220b071354c4ffb0591))
  - Outer Block Moves that move n slices (e.g. nFw) must have 1 < n < N (where N is the number of layers in the puzzle).
  - Execution Turn Metric (ETM) is defined, and used to define the move limit for 3x3x3 Fewest Moves.
- Clarified that any center piece may have a logo, not just the most central one. ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/714/files) | [discussion](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/710))
- Clarifications for Fewest Moves ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/678))
  - Information to identify an attempt is defined as name, WCA ID, or registrant ID (at least one), and optionally competition name/round/attempt number.
  - The competitor may write information to identify the attempt before the attempt has begun.
  - The competitor may write information to identify the attempt in front of a judge while submitting a solution (but the information must not be added after).
  - Competitors should black out/scribble out moves that are not part of the solution.
  - Judges may interpret `{r}`, `<r>`, or `(r)` as `[r]` for inexperienced competitors.
  - Competitors may supply their own pens for Fewest Moves if they wish. ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/5f9e2a09bbaa1ec5c8ae1d3bf859c6e00e32e353))
  - Pencils and similar writing implements are explicitly permitted for Fewest Moves.
  - Competitors may join a 3x3x3 Fewest Moves attempt late, if there is no risk they could have information about the scramble. ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/0eabb1602740bcab6e426a8f955318308a454b38))

translation.title: WCA 竞赛规则——2019 年 5 月版
translation.content:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

WRC 在此介绍将于 2019 年 5 月 1 日生效的新版 WCA 竞赛规则与指南。

你可以通过 [GitHub 上的版本比较](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/compare/official-2018-01-01...release-candidate-2019-04-04)查看全部改动。如果不想逐个打开改动，可以点击“Files changed”，查看规则和指南的完整文件。改动及新增内容标为绿色，删除内容标为红色。

轮次赛制调整：

- 四阶盲拧和五阶盲拧的“三次取最佳”轮次，现在也认可三次平均成绩。（[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/8b3a38bf71836c42eab409f574612daee6a124f4) | [讨论](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/539)）
- 除盲拧项目和三阶最少步外，其他所有项目均取消“X 次取最佳”赛制。（[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/bc7e6cc28c5e1f4928951460159db5861b6fe773) | [讨论](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/576)，[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/92e626ba258998524cfe279d88f9c7b0d7acee93) | [讨论](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/658)，[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/76157f0013a3de06c50f413e4194e6a439d4382e) | [讨论](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/693)）

比赛组织方面的调整：

- 所有比赛都应采用打乱员签名制度。（[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/8ef591a2c276ce775149de5e6bba30ae160d14e3) | [讨论](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/214) | [讨论](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/591) | [讨论](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/640)）
  - 计划于 2020 年将打乱员签名设为强制要求。
- 在某组比赛开始前，WCA 代表不得让打乱员或其他任何人接触该组的打乱序列。（[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/fb33a890cff5ecc10107691fee550084dad36209)）
  - [TNoodle 0.14.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/posts/tnoodle-0-14-0) 为各套打乱 PDF 提供独立密码，有助于落实这一要求。
- 明确还原时限的规定。（[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/ea2d719fe5d7eb11ce210a9499aa1c5f4627560d)）
  - 时限必须在比赛开始前公布，而非只在相应轮次开始前公布。
  - 每一轮只能适用一个累积时限。
  - 累积时限包括 DNF 还原中已用的时间。
  - 裁判和 WCA 代表可以估算累计用时。（[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/52ce26093bd769dcee90ec925cef0d7a002dbdfa)）
- 应在视觉上将打乱员与选手隔开。（[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/21c1c3cc44816c1064d9ac4dbb14bc0e53b8ecaa)）
- 许多比赛要求已从竞赛规则移至新的 [WCA 比赛要求政策](https://github.com/thewca/wca-documents/pull/40)。（[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/476f11632d025ec500cdedd5b964b35051f7bd4f)）

其他实质性调整及澄清：

- 多盲中若有个别魔方不符合使用要求，代表可酌情将这些魔方计为未还原，而不将整次还原判为 DNF。（[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/dfaecca2213de51e7d638b623d3976f95c671fbd) | [讨论](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/545)）
- 明确盲拧项目由选手启动还原尝试，且“测试”计时器前必须先征得裁判同意。（[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/2879c0dbdb3f4c33f7bca80b8dc5a725fc7f8f5f) | [讨论](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/717)）
- 经代表酌情允许，选手可在特定时候使用暖手用品及进食。（[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/7802b0e2f48f6c7f87e78162aaad99601da33fcf) | [讨论](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/700)）
- 发生飞棱时，选手不得请求协助，裁判也应阻止他人帮忙。如果有人替选手捡起飞出的零件，裁判或选手可以请其将零件放到比赛位上，并停止进一步协助。（[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/e3f2769c27d1d0e5039fa799d5be1922122da328) | [讨论](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/624)）
- 选手可以触碰官方计时用的秒表，除非组织团队另行提供了非官方计时用的秒表供选手使用。（[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/c66106e266e5b580218f4273f7db4dddd5a55b8d) | [讨论](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/581)）
- 启动计时器即意味着观察结束、还原开始。因此，观察开始后，选手不能再“测试”计时器。（[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/fff14fe406fbe42b4f034d6ffe2df35462f3f994) | [讨论](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/573)）
- 明确禁止故意造成魔方故障。（[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/18a136749214dbfd8248f58153e23c0d4eb7d95b) | [讨论](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/538)）
- 如果与顶面相邻的面中有多个绿色面，打乱时将颜色最深的一面朝前。（[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/38e00b10f793e7830ee3dafccdf18f753e6cc43e)）
- 明确多盲成绩的用时一律四舍五入到秒，与成绩数据库保持一致。（[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/2d3bac31ed17f8c21d275f3f9fe7674ae8bb92bf)）
- 明确 N×N×N 魔方的记号。（[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/8104b4b795b2e9e993cdd220b071354c4ffb0591)）
  - 连同外层一起转动 n 层的外砖转动（如 nFw），须满足 1 < n < N，其中 N 为魔方阶数。
  - 定义执行转动度量制（ETM），并以此规定三阶最少步的步数上限。
- 明确任意中心块均可带有标志，不限于最中央的中心块。（[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/714/files) | [讨论](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/710)）
- 最少步相关澄清。（[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/678)）
  - 用于标识答卷的信息，是指姓名、WCA ID 或报名编号中的至少一项，也可附上比赛名称、轮次及尝试序号。
  - 选手可以在本次尝试开始前填写标识答卷的信息。
  - 提交解法时，选手可以在裁判面前填写标识答卷的信息，但提交后不得补写。
  - 选手应将不属于最终解法的转动涂黑或划掉。
  - 对经验不足的选手，裁判可以将 `{r}`、`<r>` 或 `(r)` 理解为 `[r]`。
  - 选手可根据需要自备最少步用笔。（[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/5f9e2a09bbaa1ec5c8ae1d3bf859c6e00e32e353)）
  - 明确允许在最少步中使用铅笔及类似书写工具。
  - 如果不存在提前获知打乱的风险，选手可以迟到参加三阶最少步的一次尝试。（[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/0eabb1602740bcab6e426a8f955318308a454b38)）
